notes: lfm3-audio-2b_int4_b128_c2048_h30.litertlm of litert-community/LFM3-Audio-2B-LiteRT: the LiteRT-LM bundle of LiquidAI/LFM3-Audio-2B at revision 9d49701c (LFM Open License v1.0) — text or 16 kHz mono audio in, text out through LiteRT-LM; speech out runs the bundle's decoder in the app's own loop with the repo's speech graphs. Published as litert-community/LFM3-Audio-2B-LiteRT (upload commit 976325ac, main 32c07192; anonymous Hub read 2026-10-30T21:51:09+09:00, each LFS oid and size = artifact_sha256). Mac row: the published bytes themselves. The GPU ASR and its 8 text questions ran on a30, an unpublished build with the same decoder sections (lm_sections_equal_y4) and an fp32 audio section, so they have no record. The Mac timing rows and the Pixel 8a text decode on the card ran earlier builds with the same decoder bytes that were not published, so they have no record.
quantization: int4 blockwise-128 decoder with a 2,048-token KV cache, int8 embedder, audio encoder with fp16 linear weights (fp32 compute), the source repository's tokenizer.json; generic_model with audio; no activation type declared (the GPU runs float16 activations by default)

evidence: output_match = the pre-registered L-asr line: WER <= the HF float32 WER + 0.5 point (FLEURS normalisation); each process 140 errors in 2,519 words
